verdict.rationale: uv explicitly ships a `uv pip` interface described as a drop-in replacement for pip/pip-tools/virtualenv and supports importing existing `requirements.txt` files, and community reports confirm the CLI feels familiar/more ergonomic than pip or poetry. However, hands-on reports note real friction for switchers—missing flags like `uv pip install --user`, needing to fall back to `uv pip` for some workflows, and differing venv-location conventions versus pipenv/poetry—so the familiar-interface promise isn't fully seamless. Missing for 10: full flag parity with pip (e.g., --user), confirmed smooth Docker/CI parity, and broader independent validation beyond a few HN threads.
